question: **Identify the correctly spelt sentence.**

options.text: It is believed that a catarpillar can become a butterfly.
It is believed that a caterpillar can become a butterfly.
It is believed that a catterpillar can become a butterfly.
It is believed that a caterpilar can become a butterfly.

solution:
The correct answer is: **It is believed that a caterpillar can become a butterfly**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The misspellings in the options revolve around the term "**caterpillar**".
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**caterpillar**", which refers to the larval stage of a butterfly or moth. (तितली या पतंगे का लार्वा चरण)

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Catarpillar**' (Option 1): This spelling is incorrect. It may confuse readers and disrupt communication.
 
• '**Catterpillar**' (Option 3): This is another misspelled version of "caterpillar".
 
• '**Caterpilar**' (Option 4): This is close to the correct spelling, but again, it's wrong.
